summary.overview: In the "Jack x Ahmed: Catch Up" meeting, the participants discussed various personal and professional updates. Ahmed shared insights about his gym routine, notably his experience with leg day, before transitioning to work-related matters where he outlined his management of the CSG project alongside Heather and provided updates on the CRM setup with Danny. They talked about Jack's efforts to secure new buyers for the TSG project, including a potential call with Smolen from Advantage Smolin, while Ahmed planned to bring in more companies for TSG. The meeting also addressed strategies for following up with unresponsive leads and identified potential leads from various companies. Action items were assigned, with Ahmed tasked with coordinating with Heather and compiling potential buyers, while Jack was to arrange calls and follow up on key projects.
